title: decode_body_value(): QP is_truncated false-negative for soft-line-break-heavy content
description: decode.rs: for QuotedPrintable encoding, the input is pre-truncated to max_bytes*4 characters before decoding. If that pre-truncated window decodes to <= max_bytes bytes (possible when the QP contains many soft line breaks '=\r\n', which each consume 3 QP chars but decode to 0 bytes), is_truncated will be false even though the full body contains more than max_bytes decoded bytes. The decoded value itself is correctly bounded; only the is_truncated metadata flag is wrong. Trigger: max_bytes=5, body is 100 QP-encoded bytes where the first 20 QP chars (5*4) decode to < 5 bytes due to soft line breaks. is_truncated=false, but the full body has > 5 decoded bytes.
close_reason: Fixed: qp_input_was_limited flag now tracks QP pre-truncation; truncation check uses it alongside b64_input_was_limited.
